purpose: Select the Qwen reference document-retrieval query task explicitly for fresh native evaluation without silently applying conversation-specific instructions to SciFact.
behavior: Documents task changes only query prompting and effective embedding space; default UserMessages, Conversation instructions, passage inputs, model width and 2048-token cap are preserved.
regression_coverage: Synthetic Qwen forward passes prove passage vectors stay identical while query vectors change under Documents and return exactly to the original after restoring UserMessages.
Installing a same-dimensional embedder with another query task is rejected without replacing the active model stages.
limits: No real model inference, corpus generation, retrieval quality or performance measurement is included in this focused validation.
